title: Read-only Business Central context smoke test
goal: Open Business Central with existing storageState, prove the expected sandbox instance and company context, and write compact no-write evidence.
safetyGates: Abort if URL does not contain MCP_1_20260210.
Abort if company URL parameter is not RM-DEMO.
Abort if a dialog with OK, Yes, Ja, Post, Preview, Delete, New or Edit appears.
Abort on any ambiguous company or instance context.
Do not click global actions or unsafe buttons.
acceptanceCriteria: Business Central opens with existing storageState.
Instance MCP_1_20260210 is confirmed from URL.
Company RM-DEMO is confirmed from URL parameter.
Role Center or Business Central shell is visible.
Result JSON contains no-write, no-post, no-preview, no-draft and no-setup-change flags.

proved: Business Central URL stayed in MCP_1_20260210.
Business Central shell was visible with existing storageState.
No write/post/preview/draft/setup action was triggered by the smoke test.
limits: Company was confirmed from URL context only.
No business process, posting readiness, ledger trace or book screenshot was tested.

nextSafeAction: Normalize result evidence and wait for explicit approval before any state-finalize --write.
